race.description: South Coast Fish Processors Mdn Plate (C1)
race.comment: ALAMAGAN (7) landed in a midfield position last start and finished 2.3L off the winner at Moruya. Can settle in a similar position here after missing as the race favourite last start with Loy sticking. Rates highly on the back of his latest effort though and can land the knockout blow. DUNWITHYA (1) didn't have the best of luck when over 1750m at Muswellbrook last time out, though that has turned out a strong form reference. The inside alley should help his chances and he can fire a shot coming back to the mile. TIS NO MAN (6) has been racing well on heavy decks lately, missing by 6.7L at Wagga. A firmer deck this time won't be an issue and he can put his best foot forward again. THE ARROW (9) missed by 1L last start at Moruya but rates well off that effort. Can be in the finish.
